added.summary: TSX controls play the style pack's `sounds`: `hover` as the mouse comes over a control, `press` when it is clicked, `confirm` when the confirm action presses it, and `confirm`/`back` when its `onAction` takes them. A component slot's sounds (`"Button.plate": { "press": … }`, the slot `packClass("Button", "plate")` names, its variant before it) come before the pack-wide ones; `confirm` and `back` fall back to `press`. Before, the new core played no pack sounds.
